died.name: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis

born.name: Li Bai
born.cause: According to popular legend, the Chinese poet got drunk while riding his boat along the Yangtze River and tried to hug the moon's reflection. He then fell off and drowned.

born.name: Johann Gottlieb Fichte
born.cause: to an attendant who brought him medicine
born.last_words: Leave it alone; I need no medicine; I feel that I am well.

born.name: Albert Fish
born.desc: American serial killer, child rapist and cannibal
born.last_words: What a thrill it will be to die in the electric chair... the supreme thrill, the only one I haven't tried.

born.name: Wilson Mizner

born.last_words: Why should I talk to you? I've just been talking to your boss.

born.name: Nancy Astor, Viscountess Astor

born.last_words: Am I dying or is this my birthday?

born.name: Malcolm X

born.last_words: Brothers! Brothers, please! This is a house of peace!
